DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この花束の下に袋があります。持ち帰る前に外したほうが軽くなりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 花束下部袋を移動前に外すと軽くなるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a bag under this bouquet. Would removing it before taking it home make it lighter?
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether removing the bag at the bouquet's base before travel would make it lighter. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは保水のための袋です。外さず、傾けないようにお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: That bag keeps the flowers hydrated. Leave it on and carry the bouquet without tilting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 包装の余りと思いました。まだ外していませんが、横にして鞄へ入れようとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 保水を包装余りと誤解し未除去だが横向き鞄収納予定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was leftover wrapping. I have not removed it, but I was about to lay the bouquet sideways in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you mistook the hydration bag for excess wrapping, have not removed it, and intended to pack it sideways. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 横向きに入れず、花束を支えて運んでください。移動時間はどのくらいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not pack it sideways; support the bouquet while carrying it. How long is your journey?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 徒歩で二十分です。別の大きい荷物は友人に持ってもらえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 徒歩二十分で他荷物を同行者へ頼み花を支えられると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Twenty minutes on foot. My friend can carry my other large bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it is a twenty-minute walk and your companion can carry the other luggage so you can support the flowers. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 両手が使えるなら縦に支えやすくなります。受取る方へも袋の存在をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: With both hands free, it is easier to support it upright. Tell the recipient about the bag too.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家では立てて置き、友人へ渡すときに保水袋を外すタイミングも説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家で立置きし受取人へ袋の開け方も説明したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will stand it upright at home, and when giving it to my friend, I would also like to explain when to remove the hydration bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to explain upright placement at home and how to open the bag to the recipient too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 置き方と開け方の案内をこちらへ添えます。ご不明な部分はお聞きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will include instructions for placing it and opening it. Ask about any unclear parts.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 保水袋を付けたまま縦に運び、渡す相手へ案内も一緒に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋保持縦運搬と受取人への案内引継ぎをすると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will carry it upright with the hydration bag attached and pass the instructions to the recipient too.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will keep the bag, carry it upright, and pass the guidance to the recipient. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お気をつけてお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Take care carrying it. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駐輪の精算をしましたが、自転車が外れません。この番号の所でよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 精算後駐輪解除できず現在区画の正誤確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I paid the bicycle parking fee, but the bicycle will not release. I would like to check whether I am at the correct number.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: After paying, ask to check whether this is the right parking bay because the bicycle will not release. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 精算した番号と、いま触れようとしている区画を見ましょう。自転車にはまだ触っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us compare the number you paid for with the bay you are about to touch. Have you not touched the bicycle yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。控えは十二番ですが、今いる所は二十一番です。似た銀色の自転車を見て来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控え十二番と現在二十一番不一致で色だけで移動したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Correct. The receipt says twelve, but I am at twenty-one. I came over after seeing a similar silver bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your receipt is twelve but you are at twenty-one after going by the similar color alone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号が違いますので、こちらの車体へ触らず、ご自身が停めた所へ戻りましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The numbers differ, so do not touch this bicycle; let us return to where you parked yours.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 控えの十二番を探します。色だけで自分の物と考えてはいけませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 控えの本人番号へ戻り色のみ所有判断しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will look for number twelve on the receipt. I should not decide it is mine based only on the color.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will return to your own receipt number and not judge ownership by color alone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人の鍵と特徴も確かめてください。精算したから周りの区画が全部外れるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check your own key and identifying features too. Paying does not release every surrounding bay.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十二番に自分の青いベルが見えます。ここで鍵の対応を確認してから出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 十二番青ベルを特徴に本人鍵対応確認後取り出したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can see my blue bell at number twelve. I want to check the key matches here before taking it out.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Identify your blue bell at twelve and ask to retrieve the bicycle after checking your key matches. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。設備から取り出す方法も現地の案内で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Also check the on-site instructions for removing it from the equipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 十二番の本人車体を鍵とベルで照合し、二十一番の他人の車体には触らずに出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人番号鍵特徴一致の車体のみ出し別人車体未接触を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will match my bicycle at twelve using the key and bell, then take it out without touching someone else's bicycle at twenty-one.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you will retrieve only your matched number, key, and features, without touching the other person's bicycle. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。出口では通行に気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Watch for traffic at the exit on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人二人への手紙を一つの封筒に入れました。それぞれの家へ届けてもらえると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人別宛手紙一封筒で各家へ届くと思ったと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put letters for two friends in one envelope. I thought each could be delivered to their own home.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about assuming two letters in one envelope would reach two different homes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外側の宛先はどなたになっていますか。二人は同じ住所ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Whose address is on the outside? Do both people live at the same address?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 外は一人の住所です。もう一人は別の市で、中の手紙にその人の住所を書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外一人宛と中別市友人宛の相違を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The outside has one friend's address. The other lives in another city, and I wrote that address on the letter inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between the one outside address and the other friend's address inside, in another city. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外側の宛先へ届ける物です。中の別の手紙を自動で別住所へ配達するとは考えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is delivered to the address on the outside. Do not assume another letter inside will automatically be delivered elsewhere.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 最初の友人が送ってくれるとも頼んでいません。二人分を別々の封筒にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最初受取人再送依頼なしで二封筒分離希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not asked the first friend to forward it either. I would like to put the two letters in separate envelopes.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you did not ask the first recipient to forward it and want separate envelopes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだ差し出していなければ、内容と宛先を分けて準備できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you have not posted it yet, you can prepare the contents and addresses separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 未発送です。手紙を取り出し、一人ずつの宛先と中身を合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未差出しで各手紙を各宛先に合わせ直すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: It has not been sent. I will take the letters out and match each one's contents to the right address.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say it is unposted and you will match each letter to its own address again. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それぞれの料金と取扱いを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check the postage and handling for each.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一つの外宛名で二軒へ分けて届くと考えず、二通として封筒と料金を用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一外宛先で二軒配達とせず二通包装料金準備を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not assume one outside address delivers to two homes; I will prepare envelopes and postage for two separate letters.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will prepare two envelopes and fees rather than expect one addressed envelope to reach two homes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二通の準備ができましたらお持ちください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Bring them when both are ready. Thank you.

DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帯の柄を正面に出したいのですが、結ぶと裏に隠れます。柄の位置を一緒に見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手持ち帯の花柄が結ぶと背中へ隠れるため正面位置の相談を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want the pattern on my obi to show at the front, but it disappears behind me when tied. Could you check its position with me?
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help placing your obi's flower pattern at the front because tying hides it at the back. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ちの帯を広げて確認しましょう。どこを正面だと思って巻きましたか。
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us spread out your obi and check. Where did you think the front was when wrapping it?

DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この端から巻きました。柄のない所がお腹に来て、花の柄は背中側になりました。
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 巻き始めた端と腹側無地背中花柄の結果を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-04.translation: I started wrapping from this end. The plain part came to my stomach and the flowers ended up on my back.
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain which end you started from and the plain-front, flower-back result. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 仕上がりの位置を相談しましょう。帯を切って柄を移すのではありません。
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us discuss where it finishes. We are not going to cut the obi to move the pattern.

DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 切るつもりはありません。手持ちの帯で、花を前に見せられる結び方を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切断変更せず手持ち帯で花柄を前に出す結び方を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not intend to cut it. I want to know a tying method that shows the flowers in front using the obi I already have.
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a way to show the flowers at the front with your current obi, without cutting or changing it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者が帯の長さと着付け方を見ます。今はご自分で新しい印を付けないでください。
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will check the obi's length and dressing method. Do not add new marks yourself now.

DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帯に印は付けず、巻き始めた端と隠れた柄を示します。今の結び方をほどいて見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帯未マーキングで巻始めと柄を示し現状確認後ほどいてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not mark it; I will show the starting end and hidden pattern. Could you untie it and look at the way it is tied now?
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Without marking it, show the starting end and pattern, and ask about untying after checking its current arrangement. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。元の形が分かるよう確認してから、ほどいて相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. After checking so we understand its original arrangement, let us untie it and discuss.

DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい帯を買う前に、手持ちの帯の巻く向きと柄の出る位置を相談します。
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新規購入前に手持ち帯の巻向きと柄位置を相談すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-10.translation: Before buying a new obi, I will ask about the wrapping direction and pattern position on the one I have.
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will discuss the wrapping direction and pattern position on your current obi before buying a new one. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。着付けの担当へおつなぎします。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-AKT-SEMBOKU-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will connect you with the dressing specialist. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日借りたタオルを、家へ持ち帰ってしまいました。返しに来ましたが、どこへ渡せばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前日貸出タオルを持帰ったため受付で返却先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I accidentally took home the towel I borrowed yesterday. I came to return it; where should I hand it in?
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: At reception, ask where to return the rental towel you took home yesterday. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで伺います。購入したタオルではなく、貸出の物ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will take care of that here. It is a borrowed towel, not one you bought, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。受付で借りた物です。料金を払ったので自分の物になったと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 料金支払いを購入と誤解したが貸出品と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I borrowed it at reception. Because I paid, I thought it became mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook paying for buying, but confirm it was borrowed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 貸出と販売は別です。いまお持ちのタオルは使用後の状態ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rental and sale are separate. Is the towel you have in used condition?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日使いました。家では洗っていません。きれいなタオルの棚へ戻すつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 使用済未洗濯で清潔棚へ自己返却しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I used it yesterday. I have not washed it at home. I do not intend to put it on the clean towel shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it is used and unwashed and you will not return it to the clean shelf yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。使用済みとして担当へ渡します。ほかの貸出品はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. We will give it to the staff as used. Do you have other borrowed items?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: タオル一枚だけです。自分の持参品とは分けて、この袋へ入れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 貸出一枚のみで私物と分け袋内保持と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Just one towel. I have kept it in this bag separately from my own belongings.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain it is just one rental towel, bagged separately from your own belongings. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらへ袋ごとお渡しください。返却の確認をしてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please hand it over with the bag. We will check the return and advise you.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 貸出品の持帰りと使用済み未洗濯を申告して返します。自分で棚へ戻さず受付へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持帰り使用状態を申告し受付へ返却すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will report that I took it home and that it is used and unwashed, then return it. I will hand it to reception rather than put it on a shelf myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will report taking it home and its used condition, and return it to reception. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お返しに来てくださりありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for coming back to return it.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少し休みたいです。この入口の木の段に腰を掛けてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 古民家入口の木段を休憩に使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like a short rest. May I sit on this wooden step at the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can rest on the wooden step at the old house entrance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そこは展示建物の敷居です。休憩用の腰掛けへご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: That is the threshold of the exhibit building. I will show you a seat for resting.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 低いベンチだと思いました。まだ座っていません。靴を脱げば使えるのか迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 敷居を低いベンチと誤解し未着座で靴脱ぎ条件に迷ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was a low bench. I have not sat down yet. I wondered whether I could use it if I took off my shoes.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you mistook the threshold for a low bench, have not sat down, and wondered about taking shoes off. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 靴を脱いでも休憩場所にはなりません。屋外の腰掛けと見学の入口は別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even without shoes, it is not a resting place. The outdoor seats and exhibit entrance are separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では屋外で休みます。連れは建物を見たいので、入口を塞がずに待てる場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者見学中に入口を塞がず外で待てる腰掛けを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will rest outside. My companion wants to see the building, so please tell me somewhere to wait without blocking the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for an outside seat to wait without blocking the entrance while your companion visits. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 庭の案内板のそばに腰掛けがあります。連れの方が見つけやすい位置です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a seat beside the garden information board. Your companion can find you easily there.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内板のそばで待つと連れに伝えます。見学に戻るときの靴の扱いも聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内板横で待つと連れへ知らせ再見学時の靴扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will tell my companion I am waiting by the information board. May I also ask what to do with my shoes when returning to visit?
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your companion you will wait beside the information board and ask about shoes when visiting again. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 建物ごとの入口表示をご覧ください。戻る時に職員へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the signs at each building entrance. You can ask the staff when returning.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今は外の腰掛けへ行きます。敷居には座らず、再入場時に入口の表示を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 敷居に座らず外で休み再入場時は入口表示を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: For now I will go to the outdoor seat. I will not sit on the threshold, and will check the entrance sign when reentering.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will rest outside without sitting on the threshold and check the sign when reentering. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ごゆっくりお休みください。

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお困りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 残高を見ただけで帰りたいのですが、次の操作を選ぶ画面が出ています。終わり方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 残高照会後に次操作画面が残るため終了方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to leave after just checking my balance, but the screen is asking me to choose another operation. Please tell me how to finish.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to end after a balance inquiry when the next-operation screen remains. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 画面の案内で取引を終了してください。カードは手元に戻っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Follow the on-screen instructions to end the transaction. Has your card been returned?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、機械に入ったままです。操作をしなければ自動で終わると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: カード未返却で無操作なら自動終了と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, it is still in the machine. I thought doing nothing would end it automatically.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the card has not returned and you thought inactivity would automatically finish. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: カードが戻る前に離れず、終了の案内を確認しましょう。暗証番号は職員に言わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not leave before the card returns; let us check the ending instructions. Do not tell staff your PIN.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番号は言いません。ここにある終了ボタンを押すと、引き出しは行われないのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 暗証番号を告げず終了操作が引出し開始にならないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not give the number. If I press this finish button, it will not start a withdrawal, will it?
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Without disclosing your PIN, check whether ending will avoid starting a withdrawal. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在の画面を確認します。残高照会後の終了で、新たな引き出しを選ばないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the current screen. You are ending after a balance inquiry; do not select a new withdrawal.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 引き出しや振込はしていません。カードが戻ったことを自分で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 引出し振込未実施と伝えカード返却を本人確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not withdrawn or transferred anything. I will check for myself that the card is returned.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have made no withdrawal or transfer and will personally check your card's return. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。ほかの返却物や画面の終了も確認してから離れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Check other returned items and that the screen has finished before leaving too.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: カードを受け取り、次の取引画面が消えたことも見ました。これで退出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: カード受領と取引画面終了を確認したので退出すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have received the card and seen that the next-transaction screen has disappeared. I will leave now.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have checked card receipt and transaction screen closure and will leave. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お忘れ物のないようにお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Take all your belongings with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おはようございます。何か相談がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Good morning. Is there something you want to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 食堂への声かけに返事がありません。拒否なのか、聞こえていないのか分からないので相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 食堂声かけ無応答を拒否か聴取困難か分からず相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: There was no reply when I invited the person to the dining room. I cannot tell whether they refused or did not hear, so I would like advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice because no response to a dining-room invitation could mean refusal or difficulty hearing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 返事だけで拒否と決めず、様子を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not judge it as refusal just from the reply; describe what you observed.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらを見ておられますが、耳に補聴器がありません。机のケースに入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 視線応答はあるが補聴器が耳になくケース内と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: They are looking at me, but the hearing aid is not in their ear. It is in the case on the desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report eye contact but no hearing aid worn, with the aid in its case. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人に分かる方法で確認しましょう。普段のやり取りを担当者へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check in a way they understand. We will ask the person in charge about their usual communication method.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今、紙を指さしてくださいました。短く書いて食堂へ行くか伺ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の紙指示を受け短い筆談で食堂希望を尋ねてよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: They just pointed to paper. May I write briefly and ask whether they want to go to the dining room?
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After the person points to paper, ask permission to use a short written exchange about their dining-room wishes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者と方法を確認してから、ご本人の希望を聞いてください。補聴器は勝手に装着しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check the method with the person in charge before asking their wishes. Do not put the hearing aid on them without permission.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 筆談で、少し待ちたいと分かりました。行きたくないと記録せず、そのまま担当者に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 筆談で待機希望と分かったため拒否扱いせず担当へ伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Through writing, I found they want to wait a little. I will tell the person in charge exactly that, rather than record that they do not want to go.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say written communication showed a wish to wait, and you will report it without treating it as refusal. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。聞き取れないことと、ご本人の希望を分けて申し送ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Hand over the difficulty hearing and the person's wishes as separate matters.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 補聴器を外されていて、筆談では少し待ちたいとのことでした。この内容で引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 補聴器未装着の状況と本人の少し待ちたい希望を申し送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: They were not wearing their hearing aid, and through writing they said they wanted to wait a little. I will hand over those details.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report the hearing aid not being worn and the person's wish to wait a little. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ご本人の希望に合わせて担当者が対応します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. The person in charge will respond according to their wishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おはようございます。何か報告がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Good morning. Do you have something to report?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 測定用の紙に水をこぼしました。このまま検査へ渡さず、試料の扱いを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 測定用紙試料へ水をこぼし検査へ渡す前に扱いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I spilled water on the paper used for measurement. Rather than send it to inspection as it is, I want to check how to handle the sample.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report spilling water on the measurement paper sample and ask about handling before inspection. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの試料でしょうか。測定はもう行いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which sample? Has it been measured yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 作業台の右側の一枚です。まだ測っていません。自分の水の容器から落ちました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 右側一枚未測定と本人容器から水落下を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The sheet on the right side of the workbench. It has not been measured. Water fell from my own container.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report the unmeasured sheet on the right and water falling from your own container. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その経緯を検査担当へ知らせます。ご自身で乾かして、影響がないと判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the inspection staff what happened. Do not dry it yourself and decide it is unaffected.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 乾かしたり、別の紙と入れ替えたりしていません。水が付いた一枚を区別して残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未乾燥未交換で濡れ試料を区別保持すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have neither dried it nor swapped it with another sheet. I will keep the wet sheet identifiable and separate.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it has not been dried or replaced and you will keep the wet sample distinct. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。識別できる記録と、起きた時刻も伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Also give the identifying record and the time it happened.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この試料番号で、五分ほど前です。測定済みの結果を直す話ではなく、未測定試料の相談です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 試料番号と五分前発生及び測定結果修正ではなく未測定品相談と明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is this sample number, and it happened about five minutes ago. This is a question about an unmeasured sample, not correcting a measured result.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the sample number and five-minute timing, clarifying it is an unmeasured sample, not a result correction. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が試料の使用可否や再準備を確認します。記録を勝手に書き換えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will check whether the sample can be used or needs preparing again. Do not rewrite records yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 試料番号と水をこぼした時刻、未測定を伝えます。元どおりと決めず、担当の判断を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号発生時刻未測定を伝え自己復元判断せず担当指示待機を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will report the sample number, spill time, and unmeasured status. I will not decide it is back to normal; I will wait for the staff's judgment.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you will give the number, time, and unmeasured status and await instructions without deciding it restored yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。検査担当と確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. We will check with inspection staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 乗換改札に二枚入れたのに、一枚しか戻りませんでした。券が中に残ったのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗換改札へ二枚投入後一枚返却で機内残留か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put two tickets into the transfer gate, but only one came back. Is a ticket still inside?
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a ticket remains in the transfer gate after inserting two and receiving one. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 使った区間と戻った券を確認します。いま機械には触れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check your traveled section and returned ticket. Do not touch the machine now.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここまでの区間の券と、この先の券を入れました。戻ったのはこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 使用済区間券と先区間券を投入したと説明し返却券を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I inserted the ticket for the section up to here and the ticket for the section ahead. This is the one returned.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you inserted tickets for the completed and upcoming sections and show the returned ticket. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通過時に回収される券もあります。手元の券がこの先に必要な物か確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Some tickets are collected as you pass. Let us check whether the ticket you have is the one needed for the rest of your trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 返却枚数だけで紛失と決めていました。行き先と座席が書かれたこの券を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返却枚数を紛失判断したと伝え行先座席記載券の照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I had judged it lost just from the number returned. Could you check this ticket with the destination and seat on it?
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain you judged loss by the return count and request matching the ticket's destination and seat. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。ご利用区間と次の列車を照合します。残っている券をなくさないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We will compare your travel section and next train. Do not lose the ticket you still have.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 終点まで必要な券なら、ここで捨てずに持って行きます。出口で使う物も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 先区間券を保持し出口で必要な券の用途を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: If it is needed to my final destination, I will keep it rather than throw it away here. I also want to know what I will use at the exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the ticket for the upcoming section and ask which ticket is needed at the exit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 照合した券の用途をご説明します。出口では表示と係員の案内に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain the uses of the tickets after checking them. At the exit, follow the signs and staff instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 戻った券の用途を確認して携帯します。機械から自分で券を取り出そうとはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返却券の用途確認後携帯し自力で機内取出ししないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the purpose of the returned ticket and keep it with me. I will not try to take a ticket out of the machine myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the returned ticket after checking its use and will not retrieve anything from inside the machine yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。次の列車へご案内します。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-SEMBOKU-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will guide you to the next train. Take care.
